module: Career tutorial step 5 ("driveToDragStrip"): the player drives to the drag strip, with ground guidance and a marker, then parks the vehicle in the beforeDragStrip spot (stationary 1 s). Phases: waitPopup, driveToStrip, parkInStaging (triggered within 25 m of the spot). Then step 06dragStripBasics is activated. Activates the drivingToDragBounds and parkingBounds zones.
notes: At the start, the vehicle is teleported to the simpleTimeTrialFinish spot (end of step 4) and traffic is restored (career_modules_playerDriving.restoreTrafficAfterTutorialPhase).
The attention flag of the "drive to the strip" objective is removed after 5 m traveled.
The prefabs are switched 0.5 s after the start of the step.

setup.desc: Called on activation: restores traffic, activates the zones, installs the out-of-bounds reset (return to simpleTimeTrialFinish), prepares the vehicle (ignition, unfreeze, player in the driver's seat), draws the guidance, creates the marker, displays the v2/driveToDragStrip popup and switches the prefabs.

onIntroPopupCareerClosed.desc: Popup close hook: when v2/driveToDragStrip closes, moves to the driveToStrip phase and displays the objective.

onCareerTutorialLeftBounds.desc: Out-of-bounds hook: starts the step's out-of-bounds reset.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: tracks the distance traveled and the distance to the spot, moves to the parking phase and validates the parking objective before activating 06dragStripBasics (after 1 s).

cleanup.desc: Removes the zone reset, the guidance, the task list and the parking spot visuals.

onDebugMenu.desc: Displays the phase and a "Skip Step 5" button (teleports the vehicle to beforeDragStrip then activates step 6).
